command.loading.note: Loading message of the overview screen; an ellipsis follows

command.theatre.note: Small heading above the map of the canon (military metaphor)

command.title.note: Heading: the whole Bible as a territory of chapters

command.chapters_revealed.note: Beside the heading; {count} is the number of chapters in the canon

command.legend.fog.note: Map legend: a chapter not ingested yet (fog of war)

command.legend.revealed.note: Map legend: a chapter ingested but barely written

command.legend.written.note: Map legend: a chapter with its layers written

command.legend.held.note: Map legend: a chapter whose items are all approved (territory held)

command.territory.note: Panel title: the map of chapters

command.layer.writing.note: Map layer toggle: colour chapters by how much is written

command.layer.knowing.note: Map layer toggle: colour chapters by how much you have learned

command.commander.note: Panel title: the player's rank and experience

command.level.note: Level, abbreviated, inside the rank ring: 'L3'

command.streak.note: Consecutive days with at least one review

command.front_lines.note: Panel title: overall progress of the corpus (military metaphor)

command.ring.of_verses.note: Under a count of verses with layers; 'vv' abbreviates 'verses'

command.ring.of_held.note: Under the count of approved items: out of all items

command.ring.events.note: Under the number of events; the number itself is shown above

command.ring.sent_back.note: Under the number of items sent back with a change request

command.missions.note: Panel title: the next tasks to do (agent commands to run, chapters to review)

command.mission.agent.note: Tag on a mission that an agent session carries out; written in capitals

command.mission.review.note: Tag on a mission that you carry out by reviewing; written in capitals

command.mission.copy.note: Hint on an agent mission: clicking copies the command

command.mission.open.note: Hint on a review mission: clicking opens the review deck

command.mission.copied: Command copied: paste it into a new chat

command.tip.verses.note: Chapter tooltip, row label: number of verses

command.tip.written.note: Chapter tooltip, row label: how much of the chapter is written

command.tip.layered.note: Verses with translations and commentary; 'vv' abbreviates 'verses'

command.tip.review.note: Chapter tooltip, row label: review state of the chapter's items

command.tip.sent_back.note: Items sent back with a change request

command.tip.known.note: Chapter tooltip, row label: what you have learned of the chapter

command.tip.facts.note: Facts you know out of all the chapter's facts

command.tip.proven.note: The chapter's exam is passed; a star follows

command.tip.fog.text: Fog of war: not ingested yet
command.tip.fog.note: Tooltip of a chapter whose text is not loaded yet

command.section.torah.note: A section of the biblical canon, heading a row of books on the map

command.section.former_prophets.note: A section of the biblical canon, heading a row of books on the map

command.section.writings_history.note: A section of the biblical canon, heading a row of books on the map

command.section.writings_poetry.note: A section of the biblical canon, heading a row of books on the map

command.section.latter_prophets.note: A section of the biblical canon, heading a row of books on the map

command.section.the_twelve.note: A section of the biblical canon, heading a row of books on the map

command.section.gospels_acts.note: A section of the biblical canon, heading a row of books on the map

command.section.letters.note: A section of the biblical canon, heading a row of books on the map

command.section.revelation.note: A section of the biblical canon, heading a row of books on the map

command.mission.requests_waiting.one: {chapter}: {count} change request waiting; rerun the skill that owns it (the packet lists it first)
command.mission.requests_waiting.other: {chapter}: {count} change requests waiting; rerun the skill that owns them (the packet lists them first)
command.mission.requests_waiting.note: A mission on the Command screen; {chapter} is a chapter id such as GEN.38

command.mission.drafts_waiting.note: A mission on the Command screen
